# Lisbon Apartment Fit for a Remote Worker

## Option Comparison for June 2026
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

| Option | Area | Rent | Size | Metro access | Furnished | Parking | Fit for your priorities |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| A | Alfama | €1,450/mo | 42 m² | 12-minute walk | Yes | No | Strong atmosphere, weaker for quiet and likely less convenient for coworking |
| B | Benfica | €1,250/mo | 38 m² | 5-minute walk | Yes | Yes | Better value, easier transit access, and generally a better remote-work fit |

## Best Fit: Option B in Benfica
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/wifi.svg

- **Fast internet:** Benfica is more likely to have practical everyday infrastructure for stable broadband and easier technician/service access than a more historic central district.
- **Quiet evenings:** Benfica is usually the safer bet for lower nighttime noise than Alfama, which is lively, narrow-streeted, and more tourist-heavy.
- **Coworking access:** The **5-minute metro walk** is a major advantage for reaching coworking spaces across Lisbon quickly and predictably.
- **Value:** You save **€200/month** while getting parking and shorter metro access.

## Why Option A Is Less Aligned

- **Alfama** is charming but often busier, more acoustic, and more exposed to visitor activity.
- The **12-minute walk to metro** is less convenient for commuting to coworking spaces.
- It does offer a bit more space, but the extra **4 m²** does not offset the weaker remote-work convenience.

## Quick Recommendation

- Choose **Option B** if your top priorities are **quiet evenings, reliable daily convenience, and coworking access**.
- Choose **Option A** only if you strongly prefer the historic neighborhood feel and are willing to trade convenience and quiet for atmosphere.

## Sources
- Lisbon metro overview: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/
- Lisbon neighborhood guide context: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Broadband availability context in Portugal: https://www.anacom.pt/
